title: ramona × palmeri
intro: Ramona × palmeri, commonly known as Yerba Santa, is a perennial shrub that belongs to the Lamiaceae family and is native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as soothing respiratory issues, calming digestive problems, and providing relief from skin irritations. The therapeutic actions of Ramona × palmeri include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic properties, which contribute to its healing effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal and therapeutic properties.
